name: Daini no Sanmi
bio: Poet of the Hyakunin Isshu (no. 58); Porter gives no dates for this poet.

poems.title: As fickle as the mountain gusts
poems.author: Daini no Sanmi
poems.collection: A Hundred Verses from Old Japan (Hyakunin Isshu), poem 58
poems.text:
As fickle as the mountain gusts
That on the moor I’ve met,
’Twere best to think no more of thee,
And let thee go. But yet
I never can forget.
